fullDescription: A cheerful, friendly multi-card carousel built as a complete one-screen 'Glide' landing on a warm cream palette with a sky-blue + coral gradient accent. A sticky translucent cream nav over a centered hero (a 'Prompt library . Carousel pattern' pill eyebrow, an extrabold 'Carousels that feel delightful to swipe' headline whose 'delightful to swipe' runs a sky-to-coral gradient clip under a hand-drawn coral underline squiggle, a muted intro line, and a 'Try the carousel' / 'Copy the prompt' button pair). Then the carousel inside a big white rounded showcase panel: a 'Featured collections' meta row + a 'Draggable' pill above a draggable, scroll-snapping track of rounded cream cards (three in view on desktop, two on tablet, one peeking on mobile), each with a floating gradient icon tile, a numbered category pill, a title, a description and a swatch/feature footer, driven by rounded prev/next arrows that hover to the accent color and a dot-pagination row whose active dot stretches into a sky pill. Below: a full-bleed white 'Why Glide' feature band (a three-up card row), a 'How it works' two-column section with a floating 'prompt.txt' code-card mock, a full-bleed sky-to-coral gradient CTA panel, and a cream footer. Poppins throughout, Iconify Phosphor icons, cheerful and soft.

Then the carousel itself, set inside a big white rounded showcase panel with soft blurred corner blobs: a meta row ('Featured collections' title + a 'Draggable' pill) above a draggable, snap-scrolling track of rounded cream cards (three in view on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile) each with a floating gradient icon tile, a numbered uppercase category pill, a title, a description and a swatch/feature footer, with rounded prev/next arrow buttons that hover to the accent color and a dot pagination row whose active dot stretches into a sky pill. style.description: A warm, cheerful, playful aesthetic where soft pastels and rounded everything make the whole page feel friendly and tactile. The page sits on a warm cream #fdf9f3 ground, with a two-tone accent system of sky-blue #38bdf8 and coral #fb7185 (often combined in a left-to-right gradient on the brand mark, the headline highlight, the CTA panel and primary buttons), slate text (slate-900 headings, slate-600/500 body, slate-400 muted) and pure-white surfaces for the showcase panel, the feature/how cards and the code-card mock. Cards and tiles are softly oversized-rounded (cards rounded-[1.4rem], the showcase panel rounded-[2rem], the CTA rounded-[2.5rem], buttons fully rounded-full) with custom soft layered shadows (shadow-soft a sky-tinted glow, shadow-card a neutral lift, shadow-lift a coral-tinted hover lift). Typography is Poppins at every weight (400..800), extrabold for headlines with tight tracking, medium for nav/body. Signature playful touches: a hand-drawn coral SVG underline squiggle under the gradient-clipped headline phrase; a 6s floaty keyframe (translateY -10px) gently bobbing the card icon tiles and the code-card mock (staggered via animation-delay); a faint sky radial-dot 'grain' texture (radial-gradient dots, 22px tiling) on the hero and how-it-works bands; soft blurred decorative color blobs (sky/20, coral/20) bleeding off the hero and inside the showcase panel; small ring-2 ring-white color swatch dots and gradient icon tiles inside cards. The carousel is genuinely interactive: scroll-snap-type x mandatory with snap-align center, a hidden scrollbar (no-scrollbar), cursor-grab/active:cursor-grabbing pointer-drag-to-scroll, dot pagination whose active dot stretches from a 2.5 dot into a w-7 sky pill, and arrows that hover from neutral to sky (prev) / coral (next). Smooth scroll, antialiased text. Cheerful, soft, approachable; warm human copy with zero em-dashes.
style.prompt: Cheerful, friendly multi-card carousel / 'Glide' landing on a warm cream palette with a sky-blue + coral gradient accent. Tailwind CDN with a custom theme.extend: fontFamily.sans ['Poppins','sans-serif']; colors.cream #fdf9f3, colors.sky #38bdf8, colors.coral #fb7185; boxShadow.soft '0 18px 40px -18px rgba(56,189,248,0.35)', boxShadow.card '0 24px 48px -22px rgba(15,23,42,0.18)', boxShadow.lift '0 32px 60px -24px rgba(251,113,133,0.30)'. Load Poppins (weights 400;500;600;700;800) from Google Fonts and Iconify (https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.0/iconify.min.js). CSS keys: html scroll-behavior smooth; body background #fdf9f3, font-sans, text slate-800, antialiased. .no-scrollbar hides the scrollbar (::-webkit-scrollbar display none; -ms-overflow-style none; scrollbar-width none). .track { scroll-snap-type: x mandatory } and .snap-card { scroll-snap-align: center } drive the snap carousel. @keyframes floaty { 0%,100% transform translateY(0); 50% transform translateY(-10px) } applied via .floaty { animation floaty 6s ease-in-out infinite } (staggered with inline animation-delay on each card icon tile). .grain { background-image radial-gradient(rgba(56,189,248,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size 22px 22px } gives a faint sky dot texture. Headline highlight uses bg-gradient-to-r from-sky to-coral bg-clip-text text-transparent with an absolutely-positioned hand-drawn coral SVG path underline squiggle (stroke #fb7185, stroke-width 4, opacity 0.55). Primary buttons are rounded-full bg-sky text-white shadow-soft (hover -translate-y-0.5); the brand mark + CTA panel use the sky-to-coral gradient. Cards are rounded-[1.4rem] bg-cream with a gradient icon tile and color swatch dots (ring-2 ring-white). Carousel JS: build dots from card count, cardStep = card width + 20 gap, scroll-snap track, prev/next scrollBy a step, dots scrollTo, pointer drag-to-scroll (pointerdown/move/up, suppress click after a drag), and an active-dot setter that stretches the active dot into a w-7 sky pill. Icons via Iconify Phosphor 'ph:*' set. Warm human copy, zero em-dashes ('Carousels that feel delightful to swipe', 'Drop it in, tweak the prompt, ship something people love to play with.', 'Built for a happy swipe.').

layout_and_structure.description: A sticky translucent cream nav, then a centered hero (a pill eyebrow + an extrabold gradient-highlighted headline with a hand-drawn underline + a muted intro line + a two-button row, over soft blurred corner blobs and a faint dot grain), then the showcase section (a big white rounded panel holding a meta row above the draggable snap carousel of rounded cards with prev/next arrows and a dot-pagination row), then a full-bleed white 'Why Glide' feature band (a three-up card row), then a 'How it works' two-column section (a numbered three-step list beside a floating 'prompt.txt' code-card mock), then a full-bleed sky-to-coral gradient CTA panel, then a cream footer. Most containers center in mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 header with a border-b border-slate-900/5 over a bg-cream/80 backdrop-blur-md fill. Inner = mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6, a 64px tall (h-16) nav, flex items-center justify-between. LEFT: a brand lockup = a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral text-white shadow-soft tile holding an 18px ph:arrows-out-cardinal-bold icon, beside an 18px font-extrabold tracking-tight slate-900 'Glide' wordmark with a sky '.' . CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex, gap-8): four 14px font-medium slate-600 nav links 'Showcase' / 'Features' / 'How it works' / 'Library' (hover slate-900). RIGHT: a hidden-below-sm 14px font-medium slate-600 'Sign in' link + a rounded-full bg-slate-900 px-5 py-2.5 14px font-semibold text-white shadow-soft 'Start free' button (hover bg-slate-800).

A relative overflow-hidden .grain section with two pointer-events-none soft blurred decorative blobs (an -left-24 top-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-sky/20 blur-3xl, and an -right-16 top-40 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-coral/20 blur-3xl). Inner = mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pb-10 pt-16 text-center: (1) an inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-900/10 bg-white/70 px-4 py-1.5 11px font-semibold slate-600 shadow-sm pill eyebrow with a sky ph:sparkle-fill icon + the text 'Prompt library . Carousel pattern'; (2) an mx-auto mt-6 max-w-3xl Poppins font-extrabold leading-[1.08] tracking-tight slate-900 headline at text-4xl (sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl) reading 'Carousels that feel' then a whitespace-nowrap span whose inner span is bg-gradient-to-r from-sky to-coral bg-clip-text text-transparent 'delightful to swipe' with an absolutely-positioned (-bottom-2 left-0 w-full) hand-drawn coral SVG underline squiggle (path stroke #fb7185, stroke-width 4, stroke-linecap round, opacity 0.55); (3) an mx-auto mt-6 max-w-xl 16px (sm:18px) leading-relaxed slate-500 intro paragraph ('A friendly multi-card carousel with rounded cards, draggable scroll, dots and arrows. Drop it in, tweak the prompt, ship something people love to play with.'); (4) an mt-8 flex flex-col (sm:flex-row) items-center justify-center gap-3 button row: a primary rounded-full bg-sky px-7 py-3.5 14px font-semibold text-white shadow-soft 'Try the carousel' anchor (a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold, hover -translate-y-0.5 bg-sky/90) + a secondary rounded-full border border-slate-900/10 bg-white px-7 py-3.5 14px font-semibold text-slate-700 shadow-sm 'Copy the prompt' anchor (a leading coral ph:copy-bold, hover -translate-y-0.5).

A #showcase section (mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pb-20 pt-4) holding a relative overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] border border-slate-900/5 bg-white p-6 (sm:p-10) shadow-card panel with two pointer-events-none soft blurred corner blobs inside (an -right-10 -top-10 h-40 w-40 rounded-full bg-sky/10 blur-2xl + an -bottom-12 -left-10 h-44 w-44 rounded-full bg-coral/10 blur-2xl). Inside, a relative mb-8 flex flex-col (sm:flex-row) items-start (sm:items-center) justify-between gap-4 meta row: LEFT a title block = a text-2xl (sm:text-3xl) font-bold tracking-tight slate-900 'Featured collections' over an mt-1 14px slate-500 'Drag, swipe, or use the arrows. Three cards in view on desktop.' line; RIGHT an inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-cream px-4 py-2 11px font-semibold slate-500 ring-1 ring-slate-900/5 'Draggable' pill with a sky ph:hand-pointing-bold icon.

Inside the showcase panel, a relative sm:px-12 carousel wrapper. Two arrow <button>s (hidden below sm, sm:flex): a #prevBtn absolute left-0 top-1/2 z-20 -translate-y-1/2 h-12 w-12 rounded-full border border-slate-900/10 bg-white text-slate-700 shadow-card (hover -translate-y-[calc(50%+2px)] hover:border-sky hover:text-sky) with a 20px ph:caret-left-bold, and a #nextBtn mirrored on right-0 (hover hover:border-coral hover:text-coral) with a ph:caret-right-bold. The #track = a no-scrollbar .track flex cursor-grab snap-x gap-5 overflow-x-auto scroll-px-1 pb-2 (active:cursor-grabbing) row. Five <article> .snap-card group cards, each min-w-[78%] (sm:min-w-[calc(50%-10px)] lg:min-w-[calc(33.333%-14px)]) so three show on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile. Each card = a flex h-full flex-col rounded-[1.4rem] border border-slate-900/5 bg-cream p-6 shadow-sm (hover -translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lift): (1) a .floaty flex h-40 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl gradient icon tile (a bg-gradient-to-br pastel sky/coral mix, with a staggered inline animation-delay) holding a 60px Phosphor icon (ph:palette-fill, ph:squares-four-fill, ph:cursor-click-fill, ph:heart-fill, ph:rocket-launch-fill); (2) an mt-5 w-fit inline-flex rounded-full px-3 py-1 11px font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide numbered category pill ('01 . Palette' sky, '02 . Layout' coral, '03 . Motion' slate, '04 . Feel' coral, '05 . Ship' sky); (3) an mt-3 18px font-bold slate-900 title ('Pastel Picks' / 'Grid Glow' / 'Snap & Drag' / 'Friendly First' / 'Ready to Go'); (4) an mt-1.5 14px leading-relaxed slate-500 description; (5) an mt-4 footer of either color swatch dots (h-5 w-5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white in sky/coral/amber-300/emerald-300/violet-300) or a small two-item icon+label feature list (slate-500, e.g. ph:ruler-bold 'Responsive' + ph:circle-half-tilt-bold 'Rounded').

Below the track, a #dots mt-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 row, populated by JS with one <button> per card. Each inactive dot = an h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-slate-300 transition-all duration-300 (hover bg-coral); the active dot stretches into an h-2.5 w-7 rounded-full bg-sky shadow-soft pill. The active index is derived from track.scrollLeft / cardStep (card width + 20 gap) on scroll (rAF-throttled).

Inner = mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pb-20 holding a relative overflow-hidden rounded-[2.5rem] bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral px-8 py-16 text-center shadow-lift panel with two pointer-events-none white blurred blobs (an -left-10 -top-10 h-44 w-44 rounded-full bg-white/15 blur-2xl + an -bottom-12 -right-8 h-52 w-52 rounded-full bg-white/15 blur-2xl). Content: a relative text-3xl (sm:text-4xl) font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white 'Ready to make people swipe?' headline, an mx-auto mt-3 max-w-md text-white/85 line, an mt-8 flex flex-col (sm:flex-row) items-center justify-center gap-3 button row: a primary rounded-full bg-white px-7 py-3.5 14px font-semibold text-slate-900 shadow-lg 'Open in Superdesign' anchor (a leading coral ph:sparkle-fill, hover -translate-y-0.5) + a secondary rounded-full border border-white/40 px-7 py-3.5 14px font-semibold text-white 'Replay the demo' anchor (hover -translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-white/10).

A border-t border-slate-900/5 footer. Inner = mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-8, a flex flex-col (sm:flex-row) items-center justify-between gap-4: LEFT a brand lockup = a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral text-white tile with a ph:arrows-out-cardinal-bold icon + a 14px font-bold slate-900 'Glide' wordmark with a sky '.'; CENTER a 12px slate-400 'A carousel pattern from the prompt library . cheerful by design' line; RIGHT a flex items-center gap-4 slate-400 row of three 18px social icon links (ph:twitter-logo-bold hover sky, ph:github-logo-bold hover coral, ph:dribbble-logo-bold hover slate-700).

Most containers center in mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6. The carousel cards step their min-width across breakpoints so three cards show on desktop (lg:min-w-[calc(33.333%-14px)]), two on tablet (sm:min-w-[calc(50%-10px)]) and one on mobile (min-w-[78%], peeking the next); the track stays a horizontally-scrolling snap-x overflow-x-auto row with a hidden scrollbar and drag-to-scroll at every width. The prev/next arrows are hidden below sm (sm:flex), leaving drag + dots on mobile. The nav center links hide below md, the 'Sign in' link below sm. The hero headline scales text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl -> md:text-6xl. The feature grid collapses lg:grid-cols-3 -> sm:grid-cols-2 -> one column; the how-it-works section lg:grid-cols-2 -> one column; the showcase meta row, the hero button row, the CTA button row and the footer all switch flex-col -> sm:flex-row. No horizontal overflow at 390px.

special_ui_components.prompt: Draggable snap carousel: a no-scrollbar scroll-snap-type x mandatory track with snap-align center cards, cursor-grab / active:cursor-grabbing pointer drag-to-scroll (pointerdown/move/up, suppressing the click after a drag), momentum and snap so cards always land neatly
Multi-card responsive layout: rounded cream cards stepping min-w-[78%] -> sm:calc(50%-10px) -> lg:calc(33.333%-14px) so three show on desktop, two on tablet, one (peeking) on mobile

Stretching dot pagination: JS-built dots, one per card, where the active dot animates from an h-2.5 w-2.5 slate dot into an h-2.5 w-7 sky pill (shadow-soft); inactive dots hover to coral; active index derived from scrollLeft / cardStep
Rounded prev/next arrow buttons: h-12 w-12 white rounded-full shadow-card arrows that hover to lift and shift to the accent color (prev -> sky, next -> coral), hidden below sm

Gradient-clipped headline with a hand-drawn underline: 'delightful to swipe' runs a sky-to-coral bg-clip-text text-transparent gradient with an absolutely-positioned hand-drawn coral SVG path squiggle underline (opacity 0.55)
Floating card icon tiles: per-card rounded-2xl pastel gradient tiles bobbing on a 6s floaty keyframe (translateY -10px), staggered via inline animation-delay, each holding a 60px Phosphor icon
Numbered category pills: per-card w-fit uppercase tracking-wide pills ('01 . Palette' / '02 . Layout' / '03 . Motion' / '04 . Feel' / '05 . Ship') tinted sky / coral / slate
Color swatch dot rows: small h-5 w-5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white swatch dots (sky / coral / amber / emerald / violet) inside cards showing a palette

Floating 'prompt.txt' code-card mock: a white rounded code card on the floaty keyframe with three traffic-light dots, a filename label, a syntax-highlighted <pre> prompt (sky/coral inline spans), and a slate 'Generate carousel' button with a magic-wand icon
Full-bleed sky-to-coral gradient CTA panel with two soft white blurred blobs and a white primary + outlined-white secondary button pair

Faint sky radial-dot 'grain' texture (.grain, 22px radial-gradient dot tiling) on the hero and how-it-works bands, plus soft blurred pastel corner blobs (sky/20, coral/20) on the hero and inside the showcase panel

Sticky translucent cream nav (.bg-cream/80 backdrop-blur-md with a slate-900/5 border) carrying a sky-to-coral gradient 'arrows-out-cardinal' brand tile + a 'Glide.' wordmark and a slate 'Start free' pill

structured.special_notes: Built on the Tailwind CDN with a custom theme.extend: fontFamily.sans = ['Poppins','sans-serif']; colors.cream #fdf9f3, colors.sky #38bdf8, colors.coral #fb7185; boxShadow.soft '0 18px 40px -18px rgba(56,189,248,0.35)', boxShadow.card '0 24px 48px -22px rgba(15,23,42,0.18)', boxShadow.lift '0 32px 60px -24px rgba(251,113,133,0.30)'. Google Fonts: Poppins (weights 400;500;600;700;800). CSS keys: html scroll-behavior smooth; body background #fdf9f3 + font-sans + text-slate-800 + antialiased. .no-scrollbar { ::-webkit-scrollbar display none; -ms-overflow-style none; scrollbar-width none }. .track { scroll-snap-type: x mandatory } and .snap-card { scroll-snap-align: center }. @keyframes floaty { 0%,100% transform translateY(0); 50% transform translateY(-10px) }; .floaty { animation floaty 6s ease-in-out infinite } (per-card inline animation-delay staggers it). .grain { background-image radial-gradient(rgba(56,189,248,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size 22px 22px }. Carousel JS: builds one dot per card; cardStep = cards[0] width + 20 (gap-5); activeIndex = round(track.scrollLeft / cardStep); setActive() stretches the active dot to an h-2.5 w-7 bg-sky shadow-soft pill (others h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-slate-300, hover bg-coral); the scroll listener is rAF-throttled and passive; dots scrollTo their index, prevBtn/nextBtn scrollBy +/- a step (smooth); pointer drag-to-scroll via pointerdown (capture, record startX + startScroll) / pointermove (scrollLeft = startScroll - dx, mark moved if |dx|>3) / pointerup, and a capture-phase click handler that preventDefaults the click if a drag moved. Icons via Iconify (Phosphor 'ph:*' set: arrows-out-cardinal-bold, sparkle-fill, arrow-right-bold, copy-bold, hand-pointing-bold, caret-left-bold, caret-right-bold, palette-fill, squares-four-fill, cursor-click-fill, heart-fill, rocket-launch-fill, ruler-bold, circle-half-tilt-bold, lightning-fill, magnet-straight-bold, package-bold, check-circle-bold, hand-swipe-right-bold, dots-three-circle-bold, devices-bold, magic-wand-bold, twitter-logo-bold, github-logo-bold, dribbble-logo-bold) loaded from https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.0/iconify.min.js. Cream #fdf9f3 is the ground, slate is the type ramp (slate-900 / 600 / 500 / 400), sky #38bdf8 + coral #fb7185 are the twin accents (used solo on cards/buttons and combined as a sky-to-coral gradient on the brand mark, the headline highlight, the numbered step 1/2 badges, the CTA panel and primary buttons); white is the showcase panel / feature+how card / code-card surface. The reusable prompt-library value is the MULTI-CARD CAROUSEL pattern: a draggable, scroll-snapping track of rounded cards (three in view on desktop, two on tablet, one peeking on mobile), each with a floating gradient icon tile + a numbered category pill + a title + a description + a swatch/feature footer, driven by rounded accent-hover prev/next arrows and a stretching-dot pagination row, all wrapped into a complete one-screen cheerful 'Glide' landing (a sticky translucent cream nav, a centered hero with a gradient-clipped + hand-underlined headline, a white showcase panel, a 'Why Glide' feature band, a 'How it works' two-column section with a floating code-card mock, a sky-to-coral gradient CTA panel and a footer). Original prompt-library product for the placeholder brand 'Glide', anchored on the canonical shadcn/ui multi-item carousel 'sizes' pattern (https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/carousel#sizes) as a LAYOUT anchor and rebuilt warm + cheerful. Responsive: cards step their min-width so 3/2/1 show across lg/sm/base (the track always a snap-x overflow-x-auto drag-to-scroll row), the arrows hide below sm (drag + dots remain), the nav links hide below md, the headline scales 4xl -> 5xl -> 6xl, the feature grid + how-it-works + showcase meta row + button rows + footer all collapse to one column / stack below their breakpoints, no overflow at 390px.
